master.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a transparent animation sprite sheet for an interactive desktop companion, mature Pro form. Image 1 is the character identity and costume reference. Draw the SAME clearly adult anime whale maid with mature full-body proportions, about 5.5 heads tall: blue eyes, long flowing indigo-blue hair with pale aqua tips, curved ahoge, white lace maid headband, small blue bow and whale-fin shaped side locks, large dark blue whale tail visible behind her left side. Navy long maid dress, white ruffled bib and apron with one small whale emblem, navy neck bow, white stockings, navy Mary Jane shoes. Faithfully retain the reference's warm, gentle face and modest elegant costume. Clean polished anime cel shading, readable at small sizes. Layout: EXACTLY SIX separate full-body drawings in an equal 3-column by 2-row grid, row-major playback order. Each cell is portrait-shaped (2:3), so total sheet is approximately square. Every cell shows the entire SAME character, head to shoes, same scale and same foot baseline, centered, wide empty transparent gutters and margins; hair, ahoge and tail never touch edges or another cell. State: IDLE. Hands loosely clasped in front of waist, calm friendly closed-mouth smile; 00 eyes open neutral; 01 slight inhalation and soft hair lift; 02 relaxed half blink; 03 eyes closed blink; 04 eyes opening gently; 05 return to pose 00. Only subtle changes, no big gesture or camera changes. All six frames keep exact face, costume, proportion and body placement. No iron basin hat, no rice bowl, no extra characters. Truly transparent alpha background; no white backdrop, no fake checkerboard, no ground, no floor shadow, no decorative effects, no borders, no text, no numbers, no watermark.
